exposure: co-administration of oxytocin with 50 mcg phenylephrine
co-administration of oxytocin with 75 mcg phenylephrine
cohort: 100 parturients undergoing caesarean sections under spinal anesthesia at Government Medical College, Rajamahendrawaram were included.
finding: Co-administration of phenylephrine with oxytocin during caesarean sections effectively stabilizes maternal hemodynamics and reduces hypotension without significant adverse effects.
